boAt Launches Apex Powerbank Series in India Starting at Rs 1,999

boAt introduces its Apex Powerbank Series in India with four fast-charging models, built-in cables, magnetic wireless support, and prices starting at Rs 1,999.

Last updated: October 8, 2026 3:52 PM
By Shweta Bansal
Share
5 Min Read
SHARE
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:38
Instaread

Indian consumer electronics brand boAt launched its new Apex Powerbank Series in India on October 6, 2026, introducing four distinct models aimed at buyers who need dependable daily backup. The lineup includes the Apex PB445, Apex PB332 MagnaCharge, Apex PB400, and Apex PB400 Pro. With battery capacities up to 20,000mAh and fast-charging speeds up to 45W, the brand targets regular office-goers, students, and travelers. Prices for the lineup start at Rs 1,999, and the devices are available across online marketplaces and retail stores in the country.

Contents
  • Key Takeaways
  • Specifications and Model Features
  • Price and Availability in India
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Key Takeaways

  • boAt introduced four power banks under the new Apex series: PB445, PB332 MagnaCharge, PB400, and PB400 Pro.
  • The flagship PB445 features a 20,000mAh capacity and 45W two-way fast charging.
  • The PB332 MagnaCharge offers 15W magnetic wireless charging and a built-in foldable stand.
  • Three of the four variants feature built-in two-way Type-C cables.
  • Pricing starts at Rs 1,999 and tops out at Rs 2,899 across major sales channels.

Specifications and Model Features

The top model in the lineup is the Apex PB445. It features a 20,000mAh battery paired with 45W two-way fast charging. The device supports major charging protocols, including Quick Charge 3.0, Power Delivery, and Programmable Power Supply (PPS). It comes with an integrated two-way Type-C cable, a separate Type-C port, and a USB-A port to charge up to three devices at once. The body uses a soft-touch finish with a glass top.

For users who want cable-free top-ups, the Apex PB332 MagnaCharge brings 15W magnetic wireless charging along with 22.5W wired fast charging. It houses a 10,000mAh battery pack and includes an integrated kickstand that keeps a phone upright during desk work or video playback. boAt bundles a MagnaCharge Ring in the retail box so buyers can add magnetic functionality to standard phone cases.

The standard Apex PB400 comes with a 20,000mAh battery and delivers 22.5W wired charging speeds. It also carries an integrated two-way Type-C cable along with USB-A and Type-C ports for triple-device output. Meanwhile, the Apex PB400 Pro packs the same 20,000mAh capacity and 22.5W output into a more compact shell. The Pro model includes an integrated Type-C cable and adds a digital screen embedded in a glass top to show precise battery percentages.

Price and Availability in India

The Apex PB332 MagnaCharge sells at Rs 1,999 in Noir Black, Storm Blue, and Arctic White colors. The Apex PB400 retails for Rs 2,199 in Noir Black and Storm Blue. Buyers can get the Apex PB400 Pro for Rs 2,599 in Shadow Black and Nimbus Blue. The flagship Apex PB445 costs Rs 2,899 and comes in Phantom Black and Tempest Blue. All four models are now on sale through Amazon, Flipkart, the boAt official website, and local electronics stores.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1. What is the price of the boAt Apex PB445 in India?

A1. The boAt Apex PB445 is priced at Rs 2,899.

Q2. Does the boAt Apex PB332 MagnaCharge work with non-magnetic phones?

A2. Yes, the PB332 MagnaCharge includes a MagnaCharge Ring in the package to add magnetic alignment to compatible cases, and it also supports standard 22.5W wired charging via cable.

Q3. Which boAt Apex power bank has a digital battery display?

A3. The boAt Apex PB400 Pro includes a glass-top digital display showing real-time battery status.

Q4. What is the maximum charging output supported by the Apex series?

A4. The highest output speed is 45W, available on the flagship Apex PB445 model.

Q5. Where can you buy the boAt Apex power banks?

A5. You can purchase them on Amazon, Flipkart, the official boAt online store, and offline retail shops.
